annotation.title_clean: 48 CFR Part 252—Solicitation Provisions and Contract Clauses (DFARS)
annotation.title_en: 48 CFR Part 252—Solicitation Provisions and Contract Clauses (Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: U.S. Department of Defense (Defense Acquisition Regulations System)
annotation.summary_en: DFARS Part 252 (48 CFR), the Department of Defense's standard solicitation provisions and contract clauses. The excerpt covers ethics, whistleblower, cybersecurity (NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, cyber incident reporting), telecom prohibitions and Buy American clauses. It contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: DFARS 252.204-7012 requires safeguarding covered defense information per NIST SP 800-171 and cyber incident reporting within 72 hours.
252.204-7021/7025 impose CMMC level requirements on contractors and subcontractors.
252.204-7018 prohibits covered Huawei/ZTE telecommunications equipment in covered missions.
Clauses must flow down to subcontracts.
